description: Translate the default saved resume-builder document, or the first saved builder document if no default is set, into another language (for example Spanish, French, German, Portuguese or Japanese), ready to send to employers in that market. Returns the new resume's title and a link; the translation is saved as a separate resume and the original stays unchanged. Requires a saved resume-builder document. Uploading a base application resume with aiapplyd_set_resume does not create one. Uses the user's AI credits. Do not use it to tailor a resume to a job; use aiapplyd_optimize_resume, or aiapplyd_apply, which tailors every application.
name: aiapplyd_translate_resume
title: Translate Resume
